scope: GameInfo/GameSlot shared engine boundary: native match configuration grammar, base construction/reset, slot ownership/access, state changes, and slot predicates

function_types.0x6E3228: void *__cdecl GameInfo_SerializeMatchConfiguration(void *out_options, const KW12GameInfo_Recovered *game_info, bool name_mode);
function_types.0x6BD0E6: const KW12GameSlot_Recovered *__thiscall GameInfo_GetConstSlot(const KW12GameInfo_Recovered *self, unsigned int slot_index);
function_types.0x6BD3EF: bool __thiscall GameSlot_IsPlayerByIP(const KW12GameSlot_Recovered *self, unsigned int player_ip);

applied.name: GameInfo_ParseMatchConfiguration
applied.evidence: Parses the semicolon-delimited M/MC/MS/SD/RU/GSID/GT/PC/S match configuration, validates eight slot records, and commits the result to GameInfo. It is an instruction-for-instruction Diaphora match to the named 1.03 implementation.

applied.name: GameInfo_SerializeMatchConfiguration
applied.evidence: Serializes GameInfo and eight GameSlot records into the native match-configuration grammar. It is an instruction-for-instruction Diaphora match to the named 1.03 implementation.

applied.name: GameInfo_Ctor
applied.evidence: Installs the GameInfo vtable, initializes the eight-slot array and all base state, then invokes the virtual reset implementation.

applied.name: GameInfo_Reset
applied.evidence: Resets map/session state, destroys all eight owned slots, initializes defaults, randomizes the seed, and clears per-player flags. The vtable position and behavior agree with SAGE1 GameInfo::reset.

applied.name: GameSlot_Ctor
applied.evidence: Installs the GameSlot vtable, initializes owned string/network members, and dispatches the slot reset virtual.

applied.name: GameSlot_SetState
applied.evidence: Changes open/closed/AI/human state, resets incompatible selections, assigns localized default names, and copies human identity data. State constants and behavior agree with SAGE1 GameSlot::setState.

applied.name: GameInfo_GetSlot
applied.evidence: Returns one of eight mutable GameSlot pointers after a bounds check.

applied.name: GameInfo_GetConstSlot
applied.evidence: Returns one of eight read-only GameSlot pointers after null/base and index checks; call sites distinguish it from the mutable accessor.

applied.name: GameInfo_SetSlotPointer
applied.evidence: Stores a GameSlot pointer in one of eight positions when the index is valid, matching SAGE1 GameInfo::setSlotPointer.

applied.name: GameSlot_GetIndex
applied.evidence: Searches the global GameInfo's eight slots for a matching GameSlot pointer and returns its index or -1.

applied.name: GameSlot_SaveOffOriginalInfo
applied.evidence: Copies current color, start position, and player-template selection to their original-value fields, matching the SAGE1 method.

applied.name: GameSlot_SetPlayerTemplate
applied.evidence: Stores the player-template index and clears dependent selections when the resolved template is not a playable faction.

applied.name: GameSlot_ResolvePlayerTemplate
applied.evidence: Resolves the slot's player-template index through the global template store and returns the template object.

applied.name: GameSlot_IsHuman
applied.evidence: Tests the slot state for the human-player state value 6.

applied.name: GameSlot_IsOccupied
applied.evidence: Accepts human and all four AI states and requires the slot's enabled flag, the SAGE2 extension of SAGE1 GameSlot::isOccupied.

applied.name: GameSlot_IsAI
applied.evidence: Tests the slot state for the four SAGE2 AI difficulty values 2..5.

applied.name: GameSlot_IsPlayerByIP
applied.evidence: Requires human state and compares the stored network identity/IP field, matching the SAGE1 GameSlot::isPlayer(IP) overload.

applied.name: GameSlot_IsOpen
applied.evidence: Tests the slot state for the open-slot value 0.
